originals.citation: Giddens, J. (2007). A survey of physical assessment techniques performed by RNs: Lessons for nursing education. Journal of Nursing Education.

quote: It has been nearly a decade since findings revealed that a sample of U.S. nurses routinely used only 30 physical assessment techniques in clinical practice.
notes: Full text not accessible; secondary sources (Nursing Reports 2021) state Kohtz et al. 'replicated Giddens' original 2007 study'. Giddens & Eddy (2009, @giddens2009) surveyed skills taught in programs and may also be a comparison; @giddens2007 (concept-based curriculum) is the wrong Giddens 2007.
